platform: Apache Tomcat 8.0.32 + JSF SPA (Kendo UI / jQuery)
finding: The Customs site is a single-page app. All data content is dynamically loaded via a bridge proxy API. The bridge requires a server-side session variable 'main_new' (resolved in JSP) to form the API URL. External curl cannot resolve 'main_new'. The backend host (tongcuc.customs.gov.vn) is NOT DNS-resolvable externally (NXDOMAIN). The bridge API returns HTTP 400 with error 'Du lieu truy cap khong hop le!' for all external requests.

page_structure.framework: JavaServer Pages (JSP) shell loading jQuery SPA content
page_structure.data_format: JSON returned by internal API (not externally accessible)

fallback_strategy: Use GSO/NSO FDI-attributed export data from nso.gov.vn monthly Excel (sheet 12.FDI). NSO publishes FDI by province/month with registered and disbursed capital (USD) in the monthly socio-economic Excel report.
